# Empty topic destinations regression

`classification-empty-topic-pages.json` is a routing-only projection of the actual first classifier response from candidate `06a88321da8bc3adcafa495fd8f7205b49f93380` in the private September 14 routed regression run. The response had two aggregate destinations, five high-confidence append decisions with empty topic-owned destinations, and one lower-confidence clarification decision.

Confidence, disposition, destination arrays, and topic order are retained. Private source prose, summaries, evidence quotes, passage IDs and temporal facts are excluded; topic labels are neutral placeholders. This fixture checks the observed structural contradiction, not model semantic quality. The engine regression separately verifies bounded correction, final pending behavior, valid sibling progress and immutable raw content.
